description: A dark-haired man in a white head cloth and a deep red mantle over a white tunic with gold trim sits on a stone bench, bundling dried herbs and sprigs. Woven baskets of dried roots, leaves and herbs sit on the stone ledge in front of him, with a mortar and pestle at the right edge. Behind him are an olive tree, flowering plants and a weathered stone wall with columns. A small white sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner, and the painting fills the image edge to edge with no frame.
